summary: Owned canonical/rendered C and header read completely in this attempt, including previously missing L13-L49 evidence. All six changes supported. All 19 upstream non-retain IDs reconciled: six factual supersessions accepted; five section facts and pool link deferred without compiled evidence; four bite-purpose/mapping facts, air outcome fact and two composite-throws links explicitly deferred. Supported retained research inherited unchanged; no missing upstream enumeration, no overrides. Acceptance is change/contradiction review, not an independent re-audit of retained rows.

proposed_facts.reason: Ground entry arguments, callback installation and setup assignment agree with canonical code. The active table selects None=-1; motion transition initializes the frame to -1 and clears animation references and accessory1_cb. Damage completion invokes this entry before timer processing.

Air entry has the stated sequence and no local timer initialization or ground/air test. Its active table selects no animation, and its damage-completion caller returns before decrement/mash processing.

The timer test follows ftCo_800BC458. Dispatcher argument order and capture initialization establish victim_gobj as the captor on this object. Release ordering and the unordered-comparison continuation match the source.

The post-update <=0 guard supports the stated source-level floating-point boundaries. CatchCut's false argument suppresses its optional captive release; facing negation precedes CaptureCut. Air delegates unchanged.

Both entries install the same callback and setup value. Shared Anim uses the associated captor, reverses the captive's facing and enters a helper that clears both relationship pointers. All six other phase bodies are empty.

Canonical maintenance code performs mash and capture adjustment outside IASA; the accessory callback updates position outside Phys. Both wait tables select None. Captor-side unlink/Fall paths justify limiting exclusivity to this callback suite.

contradictions.reason: Accept deferral of all five .sdata2 facts and its outgoing link. Literal arguments establish neither compiled pool contents nor size, ordering, alignment, immutability or relocations. The previously missing owned-source range was independently read in this attempt.

Accept both entry-state supersessions. Frame-zero arguments do not establish frame-zero clip playback: both tables select no animation, and transition code initializes cur_anim_frame to start minus speed. Zero blend also does not generally prove interpolation is disabled.

Accept deferral of the four ground/air bite-specific purpose and mapping facts. Damage-completion destinations and early returns are established, but those paths alone do not establish bite-pummel presentation.

Accept the four Anim/TU supersessions. Positive-only continuation omits NaN, and expiry must be tested after decrement/mash processing. Relationship roles follow the dispatcher and initializer rather than the victim_gobj field name.

Accept deferral of the airborne Phys outcome claim and both composite command-grab-throws links. Empty phase bodies and active bindings establish hold-phase participation, not the complete presentation or scope of a composite throws concept. Captor-side code also independently releases the pair.

unresolved: Compiled .sdata2 properties and source-reference associations remain unverified; all related upstream deferrals are accepted.
Bite-pummel presentation, complete airborne outcomes and composite command-grab-throws mappings remain deferred beyond established hold/release participation.
ABI register assignments, header addresses, compiled sizes, stack layout and motion-union layout remain unverified.
Attribute positivity/finiteness, individual x1A6A bit meanings, exceptional-value gameplay reachability and target floating-point modes remain unproved.
Rendered helper names are hypotheses, particularly ftCo_800BC4A8; its canonical behavior is broader than animation-completion checking.
Supported retained research is inherited unchanged. Acceptance covers the six changes and examined contradictions, not a new independent audit of every retained fact or link.
